ns2:course.label: Clinical Neuro/Neurosurgery
ns2:course.description: Clerkship in neurology and neurosurgery for VM-4 professional students. Students will obtain basic skills in diagnosis, treatment, and care of medical and surgical neurological diseases. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 3 hours. Prerequisite: Fourth-year standing in the veterinary medicine professional curriculum.
